mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME, P.INTRO, P.RESIDENCE, P.MBTI, P.GENDER, FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, P.BIRTH_DATE) / 12) AS AGE, MP.PHOTO_URL, '10' AS DISTANCE FROM "MEMBER" M JOIN "MEMBER_PROFILE" P ON (M.MEMBER_NO = P.MEMBER_NO) JOIN "MEMBER_PHOTOS" MP ON (M.MEMBER_NO = MP.MEMBER_NO) WHERE M.DEL_FL = 'N' AND M.MEMBER_NO != #{memberNo} AND P.GENDER = (SELECT TARGET_GENDER FROM "MEMBER" WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}) AND MP.PHOTO_ORDER = 1
